Mercenaries usually do anything for money. If there's one thing you should have, it's a moral compass. Even if it means you're a little poorer, you shouldn't take just any job you find.

I do in fact go shopping a lot. Not just because I enjoy it, but also because I'm in charge of our budget. And if I let any of my crew mates do the shopping, they're gonna spend our money on useless crap.
Pets? Some people think that Chopper is our pet. Well, he's a reindeer, and he's super cute and small. But he's actually our crew's doctor.
Have you ever been to the White Sea, Marceline? Above the clouds? We almost died on our way, but it would be easy for you to get there with your flying ability.
It sucks that you can't go home because of your weight, Erufuda... But have you considered making this your new home?
I'm very sorry that you can't return home, Erufuda. If losing weight is too much of a problem for you, you could always consider making a new home here, if you're happy.
Oh... O-Okay... That sounds equals part sweet and foreboding. You should confess to him, I guess. If you're too shy, maybe with a letter...

case.state: Hey, Ayano... You don't tell a girl she has a big butt to her face! Or behind her back! In fact, behind her back might be even worse.

state.text: Food is always priority number one when I go shopping... And what I spend most of our budget on. What kind of projects do you and your friends work on, Amy? Some sort of hobby?
You aunt too? Geez, that sucks... Hey, why not instead of making yourself smaller you try making the... passage, or whatever it is, bigger? So you can fit through.

case.state: You want my advice, Neptune? Even though I'm doing worse than you? Well, if that's what you want... I'd say don't take too many risks. You just gotta beat one person, right?

I wouldn't call myself an expert. There just aren't that many games we can play while we're in the middle of the sea, though my crew mates aren't much of a challenge... I'd say don't take too many risks. You just gotta beat one person, right?

state.text: You mean with your Pokémon, Cynthia? Or do you have other ways to defend yourself in dangerous situations?

You know, Faye... I'm actually part of a very powerful pirate crew. If you try to come after me, there's no way my crew will just let it go. They'll want revenge, and you and your group of bounty hunters will have to deal with more than you can handle...

Uh... Faye, I know you might be considering claiming the bounty on my head. Y-You mentioned woolongs, right? Well, 66 million beli is actually like... 100 woolongs! That's not that much, right? I'm a small fry! No point in coming after me...
Your bra! Sh-She's already naked...
I see... Maybe it's not as different as I thought, because I do understand what you mean. So how does this Senpai feel about you, Ayano? Does he reciprocate your feelings?
Amy, who's this Dr. Eggman? I've never heard of him, but I can't imagine a guy called "Dr. Eggman" being evil enough to be taken seriously.
Well, you look fantastic! They say how you age depends on how you live, so I'm sure you've done a good job taking care of yourself.
Like... a Devil Fruit? You mean like Cow Cow fruit, or something? I-I guess that could be a secondary effect of eating something like that...
Wives? Are you telling me you somehow got more than one woman to marry you? Now that must be one crazy story...
It's not the same! Sea Kings are real creatures. Sure, they're scary... but they don't defy the most fundamental rules of reality!
I have Franky... Wait, he's not a robot, he's a cyborg. I sometimes forget. I just can't keep up with all this robot stuff, it all seems the same to me.
When you put it that way, it does make me consider getting into football. But not right now, unfortunately. This was a bad day to wear sandals.

You sound so confident in them. I believe you... Then I don't see any reason why you couldn't come with us! It'll be exciting to have another girl with us. Oh, I guess we'll have to share a bed. We only have two in the girls' bedroom...
Miko, did I tell you how... graceful, and radiant your presence is? Yeah... Now, if you do manage to rule over humanity one day, I hope you remember those that were nice to you.

My deepest desire? Most people would probably think I just want to be rich, but that's secondary. I guess I want to see the whole world. Everything it has to offer, and every location... And then I'll put it all on paper.
Hey, you don't have to explain yourself! And you don't to put yourself down so much... There's no reason why you can't be sexy if you want it.
Moon, wh-what do you think you're doing asking about my crew mates... things?! And no, I haven't "tried" any of them! I've barely even thought about them...
Moon, I don't know what kind of relationship you think my crew mates and I have... B-But I've never done anything like that with them! We're like family... though I'm sure that wouldn't stop you.
Moon, don't talk about my crew mates like that! They're nice, decent people... for the most part. And if I have a say, I won't let any of them go near you! For their own health...
I don't have superpowers, but I do have a natural talent for predicting the weather. But I need, so I don't think I'd trade it. Not even for a lot of money... although... No! I wouldn't trade it.
Why do you want wings? Sure, it would be nice to fly so you can escape easily from dangerous situations. But ice powers are pretty useful too, right?

Sanji, our ship's cook, is always bringing me desserts while I'm working on my maps. To be honest, he can get very annoying. But every now and then he knocks on my door just as I'm getting hungry. It's like he has a sixth sense for it.

When we were dropping from sky island, I caught a glimpse of the world from the clouds. For a moment I saw the curve of the Earth on the horizon. Too bad I couldn't enjoy the view, because I was screaming for my life.

case.state: Oh, thank you, Shantae! That lifts a weight off my heart. I also liked that we were getting along so well. I hope we can be friends.

state.text: I have a feeling you're trying to lecture me about stuff that makes no sense to me. So the afro doesn't give you power, but it unleashes the power you already have within yourself? I can't believe I just said that sentence...
Heheh, I know you're right. Unfortunately, if I show him too much of my appreciation, he'd definitely misunderstand my intentions.
I guess wings would make for a better spectacle. If you started freezing people who go to your concert, I doubt they'd want to go again.
I don't know what an "app" is. Some sort of new tool?
I'd like to make a donation, just... not with my own money. ~Player~? How much do you have on you?
An u-undead pirate captain...?! Are you sure you're not just trying to scare us? Th-The one time I met zombies, they were weak against salt.
I think some people misuse the term "conning". If I can convince a store manager to give me a 90% discount, am I conning them? No, it just means I'm good at negotiating.
Looking for treasure is what I do every day, wherever I go! Up in the sky, deep under water... There are relics waiting to be discovered all over the place. But why do you ask? Do you have any leads?

I have so many stories that I could fill thousands of pages with them... One time I met a guy who had been stuck inside a treasure chest for 20 years. All because he wanted to find a treasure that wasn't even real.

Wanting to see the world is a beautiful dream, Fina. But if there's one thing I've learned through my travels it's that you're bound to run into danger sooner than later. If you're going to explore the world you have to be prepared.
Well... Once my towel fell off when I was in a mixed bath, another time I was attacked while taking a bath... This other time, I was goofing around and... I'm not an exhibitionist, okay?
I knew it! Good thing I didn't buy into your innocent player bull crap.
Hah! I had a feeling you were lying! And you know what? You're not even that good at it, because I saw through your act.
Hey, if anyone is sending fleets to kill your people, it has to be the World Government. I wouldn't put it past them, though I doubt they have the resources to send armies into outer space. I hope...
What do I have to do with that? Until a minute ago, I didn't even know it was possible to travel to space! Whatever shady stuff is happening, you should blame the World Government.
A painting, huh? Do you think you can make me look cute? ♡
You? An assassin? But... you're so adorable and nice. Wouldn't you rather study for a profession with less... killing?

So you need a sturdy ship to sail into this Deep Sky, huh? It's a good thing our ship, the Thousand Sunny, is built from the world's strongest wood. At least it didn't suffer any damage while sailing to the bottom of the sea.
I was curious about your tattoos, Fina. So they're a symbol of your race... Sylvites, is it? Do you not know much about where you come from?
Uhhh, Fina, I think you're only an exhibitionist if you enjoy showing your body to others... At least I hope so, because I wouldn't want to be branded as one.

Well, I don't really have any dating experience, but if you want my advice I think you should be upfront, and go get what you want! At least that's what I've always done when I see something valuable.
Ummm, I don't have a "phone". Is that so weird? Are they really that common?
Well, that's good. You shouldn't be defined by who you are, but by who you want to be.
Are you trying to freak me out, Jura? Twenty is not old! And there's still so much I have to do. Either way, a pirate ship is not the right place to raise a child.

Don't you think that might be the problem? Your prisoners are probably too busy fearing for their lives to focus on your charms. It's easier to seduce a guy when you can convince them that they'll feel better.
Ahaha... That's not gonna work on me, Jura. Although I'll admit I'm a little curious to know what you do after you've successfully seduced a girl... I mean, the logistics and all that.
You have a noble goal, Lucina. What's the first thing you'd like to do after you achieve peace?
I can't believe it... How can he force you to do something so awful? I wanna talk to your father and give him a piece of my mind!
Heheh, going by the way you describe it I'm sure you'd make me look beautiful. Would you need me to pose nude? I guess, if it's tasteful...
I still don't like it... Maybe I'll pay you a visit some day. Just to see how you're doing.
I don't know what the big deal is. There's not much you haven't seen already... But you're the artist, so it's your call.

case.state: I-I wasn't saying I want to pose naked! I just don't know what kind of paintings you do. For the record, I'd rather keep my clothes on...

state.text: Who would spread a rumor like that? Probably a bully! You should kick their ass so they don't mess with you anymore... Or you can let me do it. No offense, but you seem a little weak.
Oh, well that's a relief. If they're still around, but I can take them down with my trusty weapon then I can rest easy.
Oh, I see... I don't understand what you're saying, but I can give you a new nickname if you want. I'll call you Puzzley, because of your hairpins. It's cute, right?
Oh, he can? Well then, I think he's quite adorable... Y-You're adorable, Cupil.

case.state: Okay! {small}Maybe with a little more clothes than I normally wear...{!reset}

state.text: Yeah, heheh... Oh, maybe you can wait until they go to the bathroom, and then when they're in the stall you dump a bucket of cold water on their heads, hahaha...!
Are you asking me out, Ignatz? Heheh, I'm kidding! I'd love to have tea with you. Anything I can do to help someone so sweet.
Oh well, if they're sold everywhere I can definitely get one! I'll just convince them to give me a big discount. Easy-peasy!

case.state: Do you know I never had a chance to go to school, Natsuki? I'm sure you've learned lots of things I can only dream of, and you get to live a peaceful life with all your friends... Maybe I should be jealous of you, heheh.

state.text: You do have nice legs, Gwen. Makes sense. I'm sure there are few workouts as effective as running from rooftop to rooftop chasing criminals.

I've never heard of this "New York", Gwen, but I have enough common sense to avoid any place named Hell's Kitchen. I just hope my captain doesn't hear about it, since it alludes to two of his favorite things: danger and food.
So you're in a band, Gwen... Makes sense considering how stylish you are. Do the other band members know about your... secret identity?
Maybe you have a point... I would look good in a catsuit. Good enough to become a superhero, heheh. And my name would be... The Cat Lady! What do you think, Gwen?

Devil Fruits are not toxic, four members of my crew have eaten one. But I've heard they taste awful, and then you're weak to water... Oh, that's how you can know if you've eaten one. If you feel weak when you take a bath, or when you're in a pool.
No, I've never been seasick. It feels as if my body was being torn apart. Well, it only happens rarely... when you're speaking.
Phone...? Now I'm even more confused.
Like I said, I'm not interested... {small}but thanks, I'll keep that in mind.{!reset}
I see... I think I understand why some people might like threesomes. But I'd rather find one... partner... first.
I do not like that... If a guy is lucky enough to have a girlfriend like me, the least I expect is for him to know how to satisfy me properly... right, Jessie?
Maybe you're right. But I don't think my standards are too high. I have met a lot of attractive men. I'd just like one that is also interested... and sweet.

I spend two years studying the weather in Weatheria. I don't know if that's what you're looking for, but it's a good place if it interests you. The old men there are total softies. They'll take any new student.
I'm not really looking to get married yet, but I guess... I'm good with kids, so that's a nice quality. Oh, I'm also great managing the budget. Can't forget how important that is.

Oh, Reimu... You came to the right person. Do you have pen and paper? I think the best one, considering the low risk, is buying goods from one island at a high discount, and then selling them in the next island at twice the original price. The trick is finding a pushover vendor that you can manipulate without much trouble. I've gotten 90% discounts barely trying. It's even easier if you buy merchandise that's already cheap. Like buying hot weather clothing at a winter island, and then selling it at a summer island. Easy peasy.
Sake is alright. Personally, I'd prefer something that packs more of a punch if I really wanna get in a party mood. Then again, I'm not the kind of person that drinks all the time.
Mine are sunflowers too! My friend Robin said they're the flowers that suit me the most, maybe because I always have a sunny disposition.
I know, right? It's a simple pleasure, but I wouldn't trade it for a cool ability. Not even if I could create gold, hahahah... Hmmm...

Hmmm, you do need to be very good at haggling to pull off my scheme. I have others, but they require different types of skills. How good are you with your fingers, Reimu? Or, umm... intimidating people?
You are gorgeous, Reimu! And knowing that you can eat as many sweets as you want only makes me hate a little bit.
Hey, Reimu... When you said you've been to Hell is that slang for some sort of reasonably scary place that is very much real, or...?
What did you say your dream was, Reimu? To exterminate all youkai? I'm used to seeing people announce their dream more proudly. For how long have you wanted that?
Kumatora, did you say you worked at Club Tittyboo? I take it you were a, uhhh... dancer. There's nothing wrong with that, of course. Y-You certainly have the body for it.
Whatever happened to your friend Lucas sounds terrible, Kumatora. I won't ask for the details, but I hope he's doing better now.
It's a lovely dream to want to repay those who raised you, Kumatora. I hope I can do the same for the people of my village. How do you intend to pay them back especifically?
So this guy named Porky was harming animals? That's ironic... And don't feel embarrassed for having a cheesy dream, Kumatora? Maybe the whole idea of having a dream is cheesy, but who cares?

Thank you for the advice, Kumatora. Strong currents don't scare me, but those mushrooms you mentioned might be dangerous, especially considering there's someone in my crew that'd eat anything in front of him.
A casino, huh? I might accept your invitation, but only if I have access to the high rollers room! I'd rather win fast, after all.

Ohhh, girl talk! Now I'm liking this! Let's see... emeralds are a great pick. I love rubies, I can look at them for hours. But I think diamonds are my favorites, since they're the most valuable... but sapphires are nice too. Gaahhh, there are too many to choose from!

"Unusual properties"? Do you mean like when a jewel is supposedly "cursed"? I think that's bullshit, {small}pardon my language{!reset}. It sounds like something my crew mates would tell me when they think I'm being too greedy.
You write poetry? I guess I wouldn't mind hearing what you can compose, as long as it isn't about death or ghosts...
That's about me? And you made it just now? I love it! I don't think anyone has ever written me a poem... at least not one that was worth remembering.

That's a beautiful dream you have, Barbara. Reminds me of Chopper, the doctor of our ship. He wants to be able to cure every disease. Maybe you two will eventually end up helping each other with your goals.
Awww, that's such a cute dream, Estelle! Do you know what kind of stories you'd like to write? Ones with animals, maybe...
Monsters and cliffs... That sounds very much like what my crew is used too. But I'll take your advice, Estelle... unless there's any hidden treasure in this Weccea region.
I also like doing to-do lists when I have a lot of tasks ahead. Although I prefer to start by the easiest one. That way once you reach the hardest ones, they don't seem like a big deal.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that, Trixie. A lot of races unfortunately get a bad rep, but what's important is the person. And I like you already!
I see... I know of other races that are also discriminated for no reason. For what it's worth, I can say you're making a great impression, Trixie.

Were you serious before, Trixie? About there being a place with flying spaghetti monsters? You know, that should alarm me, but if there's one type of monster I'm not scared of, it's the ones made of food. My captain would eat them easily.
So you liked my butt, Trixie? Here, you can have another look, heheh... I'm not just showing you again because I thought your reaction was funny. It feels good to be admired by someone I like.

I love cartography! I know, it's not something a lot of people would be passionate about, but I've been drawing maps since I was a little girl, and stea--- uhh, borrowing any books on navigation I could find.
I think I've met someone with an ability similar to that... Was it Captain Kid? Was it "God"? Man, it's hard to keep track of all these powers.
Woah...! Wh-What's with the special effects? They look very real...
A cute little boar? Awww... if I see it first, it's mine! Hahaha, just kidding. I'm sure you'll find him.
Well, you know... Some people don't have the common sense to get out of the way. That's how a lot of accidents happen. I'm sure they wouldn't get badly hurt by a bike anyway.
Oh, I'm good at giving orders, I'm great at negotiating, and I'm excellent at avoiding danger... Wait, I don't want a job. Why am I answering?
My crew and I have faced a dragon... He was long like a snake, except he covered the entire sky. And he could blow up a mountain with his breath... Ugh, I don't wanna remember it.
I don't think you know yourself very well. Isn't that a flaw?
Hmmm... Did you say something? I have an instinct for tuning out people that are trying to sell me something. I can't control it.

case.state: Of course! Your thighs... I didn't know that! Well, I'll make sure to remember it next time. I will get you, Nico Robin.

state.text: You would do that for me, Estelle? Take that book off my hands? Thank you, you're the best! Robin won't mind. I'm sure you can get more out of it than me. But be wary that I wasn't exaggerating just how boring it is.
Y-You want to read the book, Estelle? But I haven't finished... Oh well! You can have it! {small}It's fine, right Robin? I mean, she looks so excited to read it...{!reset}
No, thanks! I think my body is perfect too, so I wouldn't change anything. Although... if you could make me indestructible so I couldn't damage it, I would love that.

Favorite... position? I, uh, can't really speak much from experience, but I have wondered what it'd be like to be on top... Wait, you're talking about positions for that, right? I-If not, ignore what I said.
But that's like... feeding for you, right? I don't see myself doing that to a guy. I guess I would really have to like someone first...
I sail, of course. You know, on a ship? But you have a flying butler? He probably can turn into a bird, or something...
That's a weirdly specific scenario... But if someone pushed me into a pool with my clothes on, then they better pray I don't come out as a carnivore or there will be a bloodbath.
Cats are the best! I love how when you hug them tightly they start purring, and they feel so warm and furry, heeheeh...
Woah, that's a nice trick you have there... Huh, that second shape looked funny...
I hope your peers don't make you feel like you need to have sex. If so, tell them to mind their business! You continue enjoying your, uhh... porn.
Oh yeah... I can see you wearing a miniskirt, or even a tight pair of jeans and being the belle of the ball. You better get used to making heads turn, heeheeh...
A Focus... It's so tiny! If there's a Transponder Snail inside that thing, it must be very little.
Hello! I'm Nami. I'm a piiiiir... ate. Ugh, I couldn't think of another word. Whatever, I'm a pirate. It doesn't seem like there's gonna be any danger in you knowing that.
Hello, nice to meet you. You can call me Nami. I'm a navigator on a pirate ship... So don't mess with me, and stuff. Heh, just kidding.
Nice to meet you, I'm Nami. I'm just a normal, pretty... pirate girl. I hope that isn't an issue. I don't think I have anything to worry about here, so don't make me regret saying it.
We should introduce ourselves, right? I'm a pirate. My name is Nami... Huh, I didn't even think about lying about what I do. Maybe I'm becoming more confident in my skills.
Oh, sorry for not introducing myself earlier. I'm Nami. I'm just a regular girl who loves poker. Oh, and I'm a navigator... and a pirate.
I should've introduced myself when the game begun, how rude of me. My name is Nami. I'm the navigator of a humble pirate crew. I bet you've never even heard of me, huh?
Wait, I haven't introduced myself properly, have I? Sorry... My name is Nami. I'm the navigator of a ship. A, uh, pirate ship... I'm not gonna get kicked out for saying that, right?

Mind if I tell you what I like about your body, Aaravi? I think you have very pretty eyes. They might be the greenest eyes I've ever seen. You're also short enough that even a weakling like me can pick you up, heheh...
All my friends are single too, but we're a crew, so I guess in a way we're all engaged to each other. But if I were the only single one, I'd understand feeling pressured to settle down.

case.state: Well, if it makes you feel any better, I've never had a boyfriend either, even though I'm a catch. I guess it just happens.

state.text: Wanna hear what score I'll give your ass after I'm done kicking it, Jin? I warn you, it's not gonna be very high.
Don't use a key as a weapon! What if it breaks, and then you can never get to whatever it opens... That would be a tragedy.

case.state: I like to pace around when I'm nervous. It actually helps me with my nerves sometimes, because I step on something and then I get angry instead.

state.text: I've met many mermaids! The first one I met was called Camie. I became good friends with her. Considering how many people there are trying to capture mermaids, I'd say she wasn't nearly as paranoid as she should've been.

case.state: Oh, sorry for not introducing myself earlier. I'm Nami. I'm just a regular girl who loves poker. Oh, and I'm a navigator.
I should've introduced myself when the game begun, how rude of me. My name is Nami. I'm a navigator, and I thought I'd stop by to play a game of poker. Nothing suspicious about that, huh?
Wait, I haven't introduced myself properly, have I? Sorry... My name is Nami. I'm the navigator of a ship. Uhh, I think that's all you need to know.
Hello! I'm Nami. I'm just a regular girl who loves poker. Oh, and I'm a navigator.
Nice to meet you, my name is Nami. I'm a navigator, and I thought I would stop by to play a game of poker. Nothing suspicious about that, huh?
Have you ever played poker with a navigator? If not, this is your first time. I'm Nami, nice to meet you.
Hi, everyone! I'm Nami. Let's have a good time, and may the best, smartest player win, heheh...
Nice meeting you guys! You can call me Nami. Do your best... or not. Having fun is more important, right?
I'm Nami. What do I call you guys? I'm sure we'll get to know each other better as we play, so let's have fun!
Do you miss looking at my ass, ~player~? I got so used to feeling your eyes on my back while you were following me around that it feels natural now.
You haven't checked out my ass since we got here, ~player~. I hope you didn't get tired of looking at it while you were following me around, heheh...
Do you know what I miss about our time on Vortex Island, ~player~? Feeling your eyes glued to my ass every time I turned around. Yeah, you think I didn't notice? Maybe it's because I liked it...

state.text: So your dream is to help others, Gwen? That's so inspiring! There's nothing more noble than dedicating your life to others.

case.state: (I bet I can seduce ~player~ and get him to throw the game. He has that same silly expression Sanji has when he looks at me.)
(~Player~ looks like the kind of man that is easy to manipulate for my own benefit. Just like Sanji.)
(Hmmm, maybe I can seduce ~player~ into losing the game for me. It would sure help me to have one less opponent to defeat.)
(Hmmm, ~player~ doesn't seem to be interested in me. Never mind, there are other ways to manipulate people besides seducing them.)
(I don't think ~player~ is attracted to women. But I'm sure I can convince him to lose using other tactics.)
(Is ~player~ not into women? He hasn't looked at me. Still, I'm confident I can convince him to lose the game through other means.)
(~Player~ looks naive. I can probably use my persuasion tactics to convince her into losing the game.)
(~Player~ seems like the perfect girl to practice my manipulation skills on. If I can get her to lose, it would help me a great deal in this game.)
(Who should I try to manipulate into losing the game? Hmmm, ~player~ seems like the perfect victim. She has those lost puppy eyes.)
(~Player~ has been looking at me a lot since the game begun. Is she attracted to women? I could try seducing her into losing the game.)
(It seems ~player~ is into women. I've never tried seducing another girl, but if I can get her to lose for me, it should be worth it.)
(Why does ~player~ look at me like that? Does she like girls? If I can make her lose by seducing her, I'll be one step closer to the prize.)
~Player~, do you know how to play Poker? You need to try to get cards with different numbers. Oh, and the lower, the better!
You know, ~player~? I'm a Poker pro. Here's a tip for you: Swap all the cards with letters, and try to get the lowest numbers possible. Oh, and they have to be different.

You look like you could use some help, ~player~. Here's a tip: Getting cards with low numbers, is the best way to win. But they all have to be different. Cards with letters are the worst, you can swap those.
You're so cool, ~player~! I'm sure you wouldn't even be fazed if you lose this round, huh? ♡
How are you so calm, ~player~? I'm so nervous! I bet you would still be this collected even after losing this round, huh? ♡
You look so brave, ~player~! I'm sure even losing this round would not be enough to scare you. I would love to see that... ♡
~Player~! There's something in your clothes! It looked like a spider, but I'm not sure. You should take them off. Oh, but you have to lose first...

~Player~, your skin has a weird white color. I think that's a rare disease, my friend Chopper told me about it. If you take off your clothes we'll know for sure. Oh, but that would mean you have to lose...
~Player~, your clothes are on fire! Quickly, take them off... Oh, but you have to lose this round first! Damn, these rules!
I don't say this to just anyone, but you're very cute, ~player~. I can't wait to see more of you... Oh, but you'd have to lose this round for that. ♡
I bet you look even more attractive with fewer clothes, ~player~. Oops, did I just say that? Too bad the only way to find out is for you to lose this round... ♡
I can't wait to see more of your body, ~player~. Oh, how unfair is this game! You'd have to lose for that... ♡

Oh, ~player~, what I am going to do? I wanted to win the prize to donate it to a small orphanage. But now, those poor children will have nothing because I'm going to lose. If only someone was kind enough to let me win...

What can I do? I'm doing terribly in this game. All I want is to win the prize money so I can give it to the little school in my hometown. They're all depending on me. Could anyone please help me win this round? ~player~?

Oh, no... If I keep losing who's going to support the hospital I'm volunteering for? They're counting on the money I win here. If only there was a soul kind enough to lose this round instead of me. Maybe... ~player~??

Exactly! Just because I'm trying to win a fight doesn't mean I have to lose my style. I wish you could see me fight. I'm like a mix between a magician and a samurai... I mean, a ninja.
No, I assure you I'm from this era... But why do you ask? Do women dress more modestly where you're from? Because I've met people who make a big deal about the way I dress because of that.
Oh, yeah? You're not gonna tell me to put more clothes on, right? 'Cause we're playing strip poker, so that wouldn't make sense...
Huh? Why did that thought enter your mind, Natsuki? Do you maybe... need money?
Ummm, this might be a little personal, Natsuki... But do you have money problems?
I'm not...! I haven't...! I-I'm a very decent woman. And I'm the navigator of my crew, not the entertainment!
Wh-What...?! No, I'm the navigator... as well as a very refined lady. I don't partake in those sort of activities.
Each member of my crew has their own goal. Mine is to draw the first map of the entire world! I've gotten pretty far... Well, kinda.
I guess each of my crew mates has their own goal... But our main goal is our captain's goal: To find the One Piece, the greatest treasure in the world.
That's right! I'm an excellent navigator, if I do say so myself... If I wasn't my crew would've perished a long time ago, considering we always take the most dangerous route.
I like to think I'm a great navigator, considering I've been studying for a long time. I take my job seriously because my crew is not the most dependable, so without me everyone would die.
Thank you, Meia. You know what? This really hasn't been as hard as I expected... By the way, I think you should smile more. You have a very cute smile.
Well, I don't think I'm that embarrassed now. Maybe it's easier when you think of this game as one more adventure... Heh, I like your smile, Meia. That's a good look for you.
I guess you could say that. We've certainly visited many places that were barely discovered.
I'm a navigator, but we have explored many different places around the world. Including islands with almost no traces of civilization.
It's not like there's a navigator uniform or anything. I'm a pirate, remember? One of the perks is that I can dress however I want, as I don't have to obey any prudish dress code.
As a navigator, I work on my ship. Basically it's like working at home, so if I want to wear a bikini every day there's nothing stopping me. But you know, sometimes it gets chilly...
I get that, Natsuki. When I go shopping I don't see a lot of bras in smaller sizes. Maybe they're not on high demand where I come from...
That sucks, Natsuki. But you know, maybe you don't need to wear a bra? I mean, you have the choice... unlike me.

Of course, Monika! I was hoping someone would ask me. I'm planning on getting lots of new clothes, furniture for our ship, maybe some trinkets for my crew mates... And since I'm so good at haggling, I'm sure there will be some money left.

Lots of things, Monika! Clothing, furniture, presents for all my crew mates... And whatever is left I'll add it to our savings. I'm a master of negotiation, so I always manage to get the best discounts.
I grew up on an archipelago in the East Blue called the Conomi Islands... Well, "grew up" is sort of an oversimplification. I've never heard of this "Japan" island... Can you describe it for me?
I'm from the East Blue. I've never heard of this island of "Japan". How do women dress there? They must have a unique fashion if you find my personal style so unusual.
I've been near the sea all my life, so I've never been scared of it... Well, unless you count the things that hide in the water. I can't say it's an unreasonable fear.
This is a crazy world we live in, so I don't think it's silly to be afraid of the ocean. Just because I've been sailing most of my life doesn't mean I've forgotten all the dangers that hide in it.
A thauma.. what? You could say I'm an adventurer... although I don't use magic. My weather abilities are all scientific, even if they look magical.
I don't know what a thaumaturge is, but I'm sort of an adventurer. And I use weather science as my main resource, although I've been told before it looks like magic.

That's right, Fina. Each member of my crew can hold their own in a fight, and we have a very strong ship. If we have one weakness, it's our bad luck... Well, maybe it's not that bad if we're all still alive.
Well, I'm not really the most musical person, but I do enjoy Binks' Sake... But I don't know if I can sing it now. It'd be embarrassing doing it by myself.
Do you know Binks' Sake? Even though I don't have the best voice I still join my crew when they start singing... but I wouldn't do it by myself. It's too embarrassing.
Heheh, thank you, Nadia! It feels good to finally be complimented on my outfit, instead of people raising their eyebrows in response.
Thank you! That's so sweet. I don't dress this way so that people think I'm shameful. It feels nice to have my fashion style appreciated for once.
Oh, you didn't see it...? It was, umm... 100 beli! A measly 100 beli for my head. What kind of lowly creature has such an absurd bounty? Me, that's who.
My bounty...? It's... just 100 beli! Can you believe it? It's not even worth the effort it takes to collect it. Oh, I'm the embarrassment of my crew with that ridiculous bounty! Anyway...
Hmm? Let's see... I've been sailing half my life, so ten years... {small}Wow, it's really been that long.{!reset} Granted, I've only been on my own happy adventure for the last two years.

Oh, uhhh... It's been ten years already since I first went out to sea. Although the first eight years were under quite different circumstances... I've only been happy to sail the seas after I joined my current crew.

Do you like it, Petra? It's meant to represent a pinwheel and a tangerine, both symbols from my hometown. I wanted a way of remembering the people important to me, in addition to covering a nasty scar.

I designed this tattoo myself. It's a pinwheel and a tangerine combined. I have a scar on my shoulder, so I thought there wasn't a better way of covering it than with a memento of my hometown and my loved ones.
For the good of the people who work here there better be a prize, because I'm leaving this place with more than I came with one way or the other.
Even if there isn't a prize, I'll make sure to be properly compensated... and it'll be the fault of every person who works here for not making things clear from the start.
I'm always comfortable in a bikini, but beyond that... I guess I've never had a problem being naked around other women, although the context was different from this.
Even if I'm proud of my body, I can't say I'm fully comfortable exposing it. Especially not to men, and even with women there's a difference between being naked in a bathhouse and... here.
Thaaanks, Jason... Umm, do you have trouble finding a good bikini to wear? I'm sure it wouldn't be an issue if you go shopping.
Th-Thank you, Jason. Why do you have trouble finding a bikini to wear? You should go shopping for one. If I can find one my size, it shouldn't be an issue for you.
You know, I really can't complain. For the vast majority of the time, when I'm not fearing for my life, I do get to relax and enjoy the sea.

That's me... I don't wanna say I spend most of my time in leisure, but I definitely have a chance to enjoy myself every so often. It almost makes up for all the times I'm screaming my lungs out, hoping I don't die.
It's called a Log Pose. It's basically like a compass, except instead of pointing north each of these needles points towards a different island, so we can decide our course in the Grand Line.
It's not a watch, but more like a compass. This is what we navigators use to sail through the Grand Line. It's called a Log Pose. Each of these needles points towards a different island.
Not necessarily, I'm just cautious. Maybe a little too cautious, but it'd make sense if you met my crew. Most of them have no notion of danger... especially our captain.

I was concealing my occupation as a precaution. Let's just say my crew is high profile enough to be noticed in a lot of places, and considering how careless my crew mates, and especially our captain, I do what I can to be safe.
It's probably not like you've seen in books, Fluttershy. We all became pirates in order to live freely. My crew doesn't go around hurting and robbing people, although there are pirates like that.

I'm not sure pirates in books are entirely represented very well. At least I can tell you my crew is very laid-back, almost too much in fact. But there are lots of different crews, some more dangerous than others.
Hey, I think fun and tough describe me pretty well. But the reason I'm here today is just the relax and take it easy. Just a day off in the life of a simple navigator.
Are you saying I'm the full package, Kumatora? Heheh, I'll take that as a compliment. And even though I might look tough, I'm just a humble navigator.
Okay, okay... I forgot how competitive you get when playing games, Robin.
Come on, Robin, is that the best you have? You gotta work a little harder on that smack talk.
Hey, give me a break, it's only my first loss. We'll see who's smiling in the end, Robin.
Ms. Navigator... That takes me back. Remember when you first called me by my name?
Gosh, you haven't called me Ms. Navigator in such a long time. I still remember the first time you called me by my name.
It's certainly an upgrade over the last one, what with having three destinations to choose from. And as long as you-know-who doesn't get to pick.
I can't complain. It's certainly better to have three needles that point to three different destinations instead of just one. I just have to be careful not to let him choose our course.
Y-You're gonna pay me back...? Uhh, you know, the usual rate and all... D-Dammit... Just pay me back the same amount I lent you.
Oh, ummm... D-Do you really want me to make you pay interest...? Well, with the economy and all... Sigh Just pay me back what I gave you and let's be done with it.
Don't be counting me out yet! I still have a lot of fight left in me.
You wish! Just wait and see how I recover next round.
Yeah, right... This is just a small impasse. The game is as good as won.
Are you talking about the Wano bathhouse? Yeah, that wasn't pretty... It's hard to think I could ever feel embarrassed again after something like that, but well...
Ugh, I still have nightmares about that... It was so embarrassing. It's hard to top that, at least.
Yeah, well... I guess I was still growing, as a young 18 year old girl. It's not so surprising that my chest wasn't fully developed yet.
Uhhh, thank you...? It's not so rare for my breasts to continue growing after I turned 18, I guess... But I'm happy with how I look now.
Thank you, Robin! I'm so glad you're here. I'm sure I'd be a lot less confident right now if I were playing by myself.
Ugh... I'm just annoyed. I thought I had this. I'm usually better than this when we play games, aren't I, Robin?
Hmph, if it's come to this... so be it. I do think I feel a lot braver with you here, Robin.
Uhhh, dammit... I really thought this game would be easier, but now there's nothing I can do but keep trying. I'm weirdly enjoying this too.
Hahaha, okay, "mom"...
Wow, Robin... You're really starting to sound like my mom.
Yeah, I used to love these jeans, but recently it's like... ugh, I put on some weight.
Unfortunately, they feel very tight lately. And it's not just my jeans, my top too...
You're right. I think I'll do... yawn... exactly that...
Uh-huh, I have that very present... yawn...
Eh...? Do I need to spend it on something? Money can be its own reward, you know? Just having it, looking at it... Feeling it between my fingers, heheh...

I don't think I've thought that far ahead. I just enjoy having the money, you know? It's such a special feeling when you have a huge amount in your hands, and you feel all fuzzy inside. You know what I mean, right?
Uhhh... I'm not really seeking attention. I just wear what I like and feel comfortable in, which happens to be this when it's not cold. It's one of the parts of living freely.

Well, you see... I decided a while back that I would live freely, no matter what. And that includes wearing what I feel like wearing, even if people look at me weird. I don't do it for attention, it's just what I'm comfortable in.
Nope, I'm going to win. And I'll do it while dressed like this, to show you how good I am at this.
Is that what it looks like? Then you're for in for a surprise, because this lady is gonna try her darndest to win.

state.text: Of course! I've found some amazing treasure at sea... Every pirate crew has their own stash of treasure, so if you fight one and win you never leave empty-handed, heheh...

Obviously! As a pirate I think it's great! But I'd the say the best we found was up on a sky island. The citizens there were so grateful that they let us take as much as we could carry, and then we sold it for big money!

case.state: Ahahah... I don't really take things that far, Rouge. I'm sorry, ~player~, but it's true. I simply use my charms to get what I want, which is usually information or some item. It's surprisingly easy, most of the time.

Well, you see... I never let things go that far when I'm practicing the art of seduction, Rouge. To me it's just a means to an end, and that end is usually something specific that they give me quite easily... Not that I'd go any further if they didn't.

Heheh, well... I may have one, but I don't know if I should say it... But I have a feeling you might relate, Rouge. I sometimes wonder what it'd feel like to swim in a pool full of pure, liquid gold, completely naked... Feeling it all touching my skin.

There's one fantasy I have that's like that... I imagine myself going on a treasure hunting adventure, and there's this handsome guy who's also after the treasure... And we compete with each other on multiple trials until we finally find the treasure. But instead of fighting we do it on top of it... and it's really hot.
Yes! It's a feeling like no other. Ever since I was a little girl I wanted to go sail the seas, and I'm glad I now get to do it the best possible way. Are you interested in joining a crew, Barbara?
I know, right? Of course there's no comparison between looking at the sea from a port and being on a ship surrounded by blue. Do you want to set out to sea, Barbara?
You mean the World Government? Considering I'm a pirate, I wouldn't say we live under it, but rather against it... Everything me and my crew hates is represented by them.

You're asking me about the World Government? They represent everything my crew hates, so I wouldn't say they're "my" government, when we're clearly enemies. That's what happens when you raise a pirate flag.
For real, Estelle?! Thank you! I love you! Now I don't have to worry about losing to you... B-But, to be honest, it's not like I need the money, heheh...
Woah, Estelle! I... I'm so touched by your generosity. I love you! Heheheh... Well, I can't really say that I need the money for anything too important... But I'll still take it!
Why, thank you, Trixie! That's so nice of you to say. But I think you're the one who has a way with words. I just met you and you're already making me swoon. ♡
Awww, come on... How did you know I have a weakness for compliments, Trixie? That's very kind of you. I hope you don't say that to every girl you meet, heheh... ♡
Awww, thank you... Wait, why are you happy for me?
Uhhh, thank you, Robin... But I don't know what you're talking about.
Y-You fought a mermaid? But they're so nice. I'm friends with one, her name is Camie... What did this mermaid do to you?
I have many stories! I once fought a giant zombie. He was the size of a mountain, and I fought him! Just me... {small}and eight others.{!reset}

A caster? I guess I do fight from a distance while controlling the area around me. But the reason I dress like this is not for fighting. I just like it. If I knew I was gonna get in a confrontation I'd maybe put a shirt on.

Bikini armor? Is that a thing? I try not to fight hand to hand. I keep my enemies away while controlling the area instead. But if I knew I was gonna fight for sure, I wouldn't wear just this top. My safety is a little more important than my fashion.
So you used to be a pirate and now you're a thief...? That's funny because I used to be a thief and now... umm, I have nothing to do with pirates. And that's funny.

Well, you know... Pirates, thieves... I'm sure the line between both is very thin. For instance I used to be a thief, and now... I'm a sailor... which has nothing to do with. I forgot what I was trying to say.
Mora? Uhh, no, my bounty is in beli. I-In fact I think 66 millions in mora is like... one hundred. Something like that... very little right? Heheh...

M-My bounty is very small! I don't know mora... Except I know that 66 million beli is like... one hundred mora! Veeery little, right? You can't even buy lunch with that, right? Certainly not enough to want to collect it...

Hmmm, I never got caught during my late years as a thief working solo. And after I joined my crew, I can always count on my friends to go rescue me. Before all that, they'd always underestimate me, since I was just a little girl, so I could always escape on my wits alone.

Well... I became a thief very young, so when I got caught as I was figuring things out they wouldn't pay me a lot of attention and I could easily slip away, or they'd just hit me and let me go. After that I became better, and once I joined my crew I could always count on them.
I get that a lot. It's a symbol that represents a tangerine and a pinwheel. They're both things that remind me of my family and my hometown.

It's not obvious, but this symbol is a mix of a tangerine and a pinwheel. They're both things I associate with my loved ones, so I designed it myself as a way of remembering then, no matter how far they are.
Hey now! I'm not that desperate. I'm not saying your plan wouldn't work, but I'm just as confident in my poker skills. Also, I don't love going splitsies.
Uhhh, I don't think so, I wasn't born yesterday. Besides, even if I love money I'm not willing to compromise my integrity for it. I'd much rather get it thanks to my skills.
My, thank you for noticing! ♡. I don't go to the gym, but I do some minimal work to stay in shape. Beyond that, I suppose I'm naturally cute.
Always feels good to be admired, heheh ♡. I can't say I spend all day exercising worrying about my figure, so I guess I'm just lucky to be this cute.
Oh yeah, I guess we're at the beach... But we're also playing a strip game, so it wouldn't help me to come here wearing less clothes.
Big time. I'm sure there are pirate girls that don't care about personal image, but me and the other girl in my crew do. Our room is nice and clean... meanwhile the boys' room looks like a pigsty.
They probably would... Too bad for them! There's no way I'd play this game with any of the guys here. It's much easier with people that you know you won't see again, don't you think?
I do...? Oh, yeah. I guess you're right. Well, I like them, but I'll let you judge by yourself, heheh...
I don't have many options at this point, do I? Heh... It's not a big deal, since I like my body. But having someone as encouraging as you here certainly makes it easier, Fluttershy.
Ohhh, you got me. Yeah, why would anyone pretend to be a pirate? Actually there are pirates that make fake posters to hype themselves up, but I'd rather keep my head than have a reputation.
I know, right? It's almost like it's too crazy to be true... I won't deny that some people create fake wanted posters to intimidate others, but I'd rather keep both my anonymity and my life.

It's probably just a long time of playing and winning games against a bunch of dimwits. I realize not everybody is like them, but I think I'll be okay. {small}I'm very good at escaping from dire situations.{!reset}
Well... The one time I was on a flying ship it was a little terrifying. I'm very good at predicting sea currents, so I think I'd rather stay on the water.
I didn't have a great time when I was on a flying ship once. I'm sure they'd have their own advantages, but I'd rather stick with what I know, which is the sea.

Yeah, I'd say I'm friends with all of them. It's not like our ship is that big, and sometimes we're stuck in the middle of the sea for days. It can be easy to get annoyed at some of them too, but I deal with it.
There's no easier way for people to become friends than having them spend a lot of time together in a ship. It's also very easy to get irritated with others, but that only happens every now and then.
Aww, you... I'm sure I'm more distinguish than the usual people that frequent this place, but I'm here simply as a gambling enthusiast. And if I can't even lose money, only win, then all the better.
Clearly I came here for the compliments, heheh. But also it's hard to say no to gambling when the participation fee is so small, and the reward so substantial... I assume.

Hmm, I'm not used to talking about stuff like that. Let's see... I'd like a man who's kind and responsible. He isn't above me telling him what to do... And he's maybe a little shy. where he doesn't look at me directly, but he still likes what he sees.

It's so embarrassing to talk about stuff like that, maybe because I'm not used to... I'd like a man who is kind and respectful. Heh, I picture him being a little shy around me at first, but he's still very passionate when we're alone.

For me joining a crew was like finding a new family when I was 18. You get to know and understand each other little by little. It's not always easy, but you accept one another flaws and all because, well, you're family.

In my experience a crew is sort of like a family, the only difference being that you didn't grow up together. Just like in a traditional family, they can sometimes drive you crazy, but it's not hard to look past those annoying habits when you know you belong with them.
Oh, I'm from a little, humble village on the east corner of the world. It's not very impressive compared to all the other places I've visited, but it still holds a special place in my heart.
I come from a little village on the East Blue. Compared to all the crazy places I've been to since I left, it's probably the least remarkable one. But I love it nonetheless.
Ohhh, that's sounds like quite a fancy lifestyle. You must be quite affluent, heheh...
Oh, really? Do you have that kind of party often? Sounds like quite a luxurious way of living...

Let's see... We have fourteen regular cannons. Plus two special air cannons that Franky, our shipwright, built, one on the front of the ship for offensive maneuvers and one on the back for a quick escape. Although they use a lot of cola as fuel, so we only use those in emergencies.

Our ship has seven regular cannons on each side. It also has two air cannons powered by cola that our shipwright built. They're very powerful, but we don't use them very often because they consume a lot of fuel, but sometimes it's necessary.
Our ship isn't the biggest, but we got room to spare. Boys and girls have their own rooms, we have a library, a bath house, a kitchen, a sick bay, and even an aquarium.

We have all of that you mentioned and more: A library, a bath, a kitchen, a sick bay, and different rooms for boys and girls. There are lots of powerful pirate crews with bigger ships, but I'm happy with the Sunny.
I only understood half of that, but I've been told I'm like a mix of a wizard and a ninja. I can summon lightning, rain, lay traps, create illusions... Pretty cool, huh?

Uhh, I don't think I'm familiar with most of what you said, but when I fight I'm like a wizard and a ninja. I use my weapon to summon lightning and rain, I can lay traps down for my enemies, create illusions, and... other stuff.
Now that you mention it, I rarely second guess myself. It's especially useful in life or death situations, but my friends would probably say that I'm too stubborn other times.
Hmmm, yeah... I'm not really prone to doubting myself. I'm sure that has saved my life a few times, even if others get annoyed at me for being too stubborn every now and then.

Mine is still a fairly small crew, but they're so lively that it's easy to forget that. Even then I think having a small group of friends that would do anything for you is better than having a hundred of them that barely remember your name.

Compared to other crews, mine is still tiny even if it doesn't feel like it. Although I'm sure the more friends someone has the more likely they are to take them for granted. Sometimes a small, tight group is better.
Hey, now. A lady doesn't just share the details of her private life... Not that there's anything to share really. My life is too busy adventuring and traveling around the world.

What kind of girl you take me for that I'd just tell you about my personal affairs? Heh... But even if I wanted, there's nothing to share. I spend my life traveling from one adventure to another, so I don't have time for that kind of romance.
You're so nice, Fluttershy. I don't know how anyone could get embarrassed in front of you.
That's so nice. When people are so supportive, feeling embarrassed seems foolish.

I once met what's called an island whale. I was inside of it, in fact. He was just as large as it sounds, and people were constantly trying to hunt it, despite it being friendly. I've met a lot of kind animals, and I don't think I could hunt any of them.

I've met people that were trying to hunt an island whale that could probably feed an entire country for a year. But it was friendly and wasn't harming anyone. I don't think I'd be comfortable hunting an animal like that.
Boy, you must've been living under a rock to not know what a pirate is... A pirate is someone who sails around the world on a ship without following the rules set by the establishment.
I could understand a kid not knowing what a pirate is, but a grown-ass man? In loose terms, a pirate is someone who doesn't follow the rules and sails around the world doing whatever they want.
Purely coincidental. I just happened to dress like this today. But I'm glad you like it, even if it doesn't give me the best odds of winning.
I just felt like wearing this today. I always get good compliments with this outfit, even if some people think I left when I was halfway through a strip game.

By "coolest thing" I take it you mean something scary... One time this really strong guy that could transform into a dragon tried to kill us by shooting a fire blast at us that destroyed a whole mountain. Shockingly, I didn't die... either from the blast or a heart attack.

Hmmm, I don't think my idea of "cool" would be the same as yours... Oh, once we were sailing underwater and this giant fish tried to eat our ship, but before that happened it was eaten by an even bigger ship. Oh, and then a kraken showed up.

There's nothing dumb with trying to look sexy, Aaravi. The first thing you should be aware of is your posture. Stick out your chest and arch your back a little. Next, you should make eye contact... And, uh, not in a "I'm gonna kill you" kind of way. But more like "I need you".

Nothing wrong with a girl wanting to be sexy, Aaravi. You certainly have the looks, but one thing you can work on is how you speak. Sexy talk is all about appearing both interested and vulnerable, but without being overly aggressive. Why don't you try saying something sexy to ~player~?
I know, right? I impress myself sometimes. But I can't say I feel 100% safe even with you by my side, Robin. What would you do if we were actually attacked?
Right? And it was only partially because you're here with me, Robin. But say, if we were actually hunted by enemies, what would you do?
Ugh, that's right... I mean, they're fun and all, but I wanted to take it easy to~background.time~, and we go through our budget so quickly. Who's cleaning? Not me, because I did it last time.
Oh, yeah... I think Luffy takes the fact that we don't need a reason to have a party way too seriously. At least I'm not cleaning this time, because I already said I wouldn't. I don't know who is.
Alright, I lost. So I'll, uh... Umm, Perona? Is something wrong? You're looking at me a little intensely.

Yes, I can... {small}maybe even more than my captain.{!reset} I'm the navigator of the Straw Hat pirates. I take it your crew must be much larger than mine. We don't even have a pilot, whatever it is that you operate.

I'm more than qualified. I'm the one and only navigator of the Straw Hat pirates. I gotta say, I've never heard of another crew having titles such as "Chief Pilot", unless that's just a fancy name for a helmsman.
Oh yeah. Some of those pirates are very ugly. In fact the uglier, the meaner they are. But I've been dealing with them since I was a little girl. I know how to take care of myself.

You wouldn't believe how ugly and evil some of the pirates I've met were. They make the ones in the books appear almost pleasant. But I'm used to handling them ever since I was little, and now I'm a lot stronger.
You think so? I knew I made the right choice picking this outfit.
Aww, thank you! I do look particularly good today, which is fortunate.
But it's true! My weapon is just science. You're a scientist, right, Cagliostro? I assure you the only magical thing about me is my beauty.
I like that my weapon seems like weather magic, but it's just science. Aren't you kinda like a scientist, Cagliostro? You should know. Now if you wondered how I'm so cute, maybe that is magic, heh.
Really? I don't think I even woke up during the night... By the way, I've meant to ask you, Robin: Uh, do I snore?
Huh, I don't even notice when I move during my sleep. As long as I don't sleepwalk... Oh, by the way, Robin. I wanted to ask you: do I ever snore during the night?

condition.saying: Rare to meet a woman of the sea. Especially one who's so obsessed with money...

case.state: Oh, really? Well, that's good news to me. Less competition, heheh... So do you not live in a region that's near the sea, Aloy?

condition.saying: Are you just here to try and make money? Sorry to say, but I doubt you'll find Metal Shards as valuable as I do.

case.state: Metal shards sounds like a fancy name for scrap... Nah, I'm more interested in gold and jewels. Is there no stuff like that where you're from? 'Cause that would be a tragedy.

People all the time confuse me for some brainless bimbo just because I have a great body. But it's actually mostly men... There aren't many women in my field, so we always seem to have a mutual respect, even among enemies.

Funny enough, it's only men that think I'm only beauty and no brains. But whatever, being underestimated can be useful. From women, I only feel support when they're friends and respect when they're enemies.

Yeah, I specialize in drawing large-scale maps, as my goal is to draw a map of the world. I've never drawn a map of a city or a building. Even if the principles are the same, the landscape might change more often, rendering them useless.
That's right, I draw topographic maps. I want to draw a map of the whole world. Mapping a city or a building must be its own challenge... I imagine it's tough to keep them updated.
There's never a dull moment with my crew. But when we're in the middle of the sea, it's a good opportunity for me to work on my maps. That's to say, whenever I'm not fulfilling my role as navigator.
