Magic? Sure... But seriously, what is that thing?
I just wanna make sure you know what you're getting into. You look like a nice girl, if maybe a little... lost.
AH! What was that noise?!
Is that sweater as comfortable as it looks? It's also super cute.
Obsession with food is not good for you. At least Luffy doesn't get fat with all the meat that he eats.
It's not good for your health eating so much. I don't know how Luffy does it, but not everybody is like him.
I've met a few people who can fly through different means. How do you do it?
You're a musician, right? Does everybody who's into music got a screw loose?
Wearing a jacket like that... I'm not sure if it's fashion or just random. You're not making a statement or something, right?
That's not how you wear a jacket... It's not like it bothers me or something. It just feels... random.
What do you mean?
Stop being so damn mean and just take off your headband!
(Wow, that thing is short. It doesn't even qualify as a mini skirt.)
Oh, I'm so sorry. I had no idea...
Is that jacket as comfy as it looks?
That hat is probably the only cute thing about you. I wouldn't mind having one just like it.
If there's one compliment I can give you, is that that hat is very cute. I'd like to get one like it.
I bet. That's one of the reasons why I prefer dressing lightly.
That seems like the technology from Germa 66. Can you also shoot fire and stuff?
Feliz Na... What?
Dancing while stripping is kinda... Umm... You know what? Just do what you enjoy.
Are you taking off your tights...? Huh...?
Time for your tights, huh? Hmm...?
Can you really remove your crown? Are you worried you'll be treated any different now, Your Highness?
I guess there's no such thing as a stereotype. After all I know this one swordswoman who wears glasses, so...
I guess seeing the loser undress is not part of the rules...
I've never had a robot come onto me... I... don't know how to react.
Why not? It's just a hat, isn't it?
What's the big deal? It's a hat...
Oh, I'm sure they're quite convincing. That's why you're wearing a uniform and all... But magic is not real.
They pulled off a really convincing scam... Making kids think that magic is real. Sure, there's stuff that looks like magic, but it's not the same.
Oh, so they teach you science at school too? So it's not just fake magic stuff.
Ah, so you have a science class? It's a relief to know they don't just teach the students fake mumbo jumbo stuff.
Hmph, where does this seller of "wands" live? Maybe I'll pay them a visit, and relieve them of their income.
I wouldn't feel a bit of regret stealing from someone who sells sticks at a high price. Where can I find this fraud?
What the hell?! I definitely saw it this time. Where did you clothes go?
Are you telling me you're a character from a comic? I... normally wouldn't believe that, but given the circumstances...
So you're really gonna strip while dancing? I-Is that what you do for a living, Shantae? I'm not judging, it just seems... surprising.
Really? It's actually impressive that you can sneak around that easily. Do you have any advice for how to be more stealthy? It couldn't hurt to go by unnoticed every now and then.
Huh, that's kind of amazing... I don't think I'm bad at sneaking around, but I'm probably not on your level. Do you have any tips you can give me on how to get better at being stealthy?
(I hope she doesn't have a demon head, or something...)

scene.name: Street
scene.directive: {epi-play}On a small island, somewhere in the Grand Line...
{epi-play}The cheerful chattering of people fill the street of the port city with life.
{epi-play}Walking past the fruits stands, you overhear a conversation between two men.
{epi}No, no...! I'm telling you! It was a Marine ship. I saw it on the East port this morning.
{epi}I don't buy it. If they really came to arrest her they would send more than one ship.
{epi}Maybe you're right. But I still have a feeling that something horrible is going to happen.
{epi-play}Suddenly, the two men go silent. As does everyone else around.
{epi-play}A young woman is slowly walking down the street, carefully observing her surroundings with an air of superiority.
{epi-play}She's followed by two tough-looking men.
{epi-play}Everybody steps aside while the woman walks past them, making the street appear suddenly empty.
{epi-play}Clearly staying here is a bad idea, so you quickly try to walk away.
{epi-play}But it's too late. Her eyes lock on you...
{epi-sinclair}Hey, you! Fella! Hold your horses.
{epi-sinclair}I don't recognize you. Are you a tourist?
{epi-sinclair}I reckon I'd remember such a pretty face.
{epi-play}She slowly looks up and down your body, her eyes making you feel naked.
{epi-sinclair}Hmmm...
{epi-sinclair}Lemme ask you somethin': Are you familiar with the Straw Hat pirates?
{epi-sinclair}What about an orange-hair woman with a tattoo on her shoulder?
{epi-sinclair}Have you seen... anyone like that?
{epi-play}You don't know what this woman could want with her, but it's probably nothing good. So you shake your head again.
{epi-sinclair}Gahaha...! Yeah, I got a feelin' you have better taste in women.
{epi-sinclair}I'm Sinclair, lemme tell ya.
{epi-sinclair}This island is mine. I wish I could show you around, but I'm afraid you picked a terrible time to visit.
{epi-sinclair}...
{epi-sinclair}Ah... It is what it is.
{epi-sinclair}Enjoy your stay, sugar. Jus' stay outta trouble.
{epi-play}The woman continues down the street. Her two thugs glare at you before following right behind her.
{epi-play}After she turns around the corner, people start to relax and the atmosphere returns to its former rowdy self.
{epi-play}The two men by the fruit stand, who were hiding behind cover, go back to their conversation.
{epi}She looked pissed! Didn't she look pissed?
{epi}D-Did she mention the Straw Hat pirates? Are they here? So it's not just the Marine ship...
{epi}I told you, man! Shit's gonna hit the fan! I'm gonna go home, lock the doors and close the windows!
{epi-play}Right as you're about to leave, you feel something firmly pressed against your back.
{epi-play}A raspy woman's voice whispers in your ear.
{epi}Don't turn around, or you're dead.
{epi-play}A hand firmly grips your arm.
{epi}Walk.
{epi-play}The mysterious woman guides you to a narrow alley. If she's gonna rob you, this is a much better spot.

scene.name: Alley
scene.directive: {epi-play}The hand lets go of your arm.
{epi-play}Before you can turn around to look at her, she walks in front of you.
{epi-nami}~Player~... Of all the people I thought I'd never meet again.
{epi-play}The tone of Nami's voice makes it clear that this isn't a happy reunion.
{epi-nami}I saw you talking to Sinclair. So, what...? Are you friends now, or something?
{epi-nami}She asked about me, didn't she?
{epi-play}You explain to Nami everything Sinclair told you.
{epi-nami}Sigh... I believe you. I knew you wouldn't sell me out.
{epi-nami}It just startled me to see you here.
{epi-nami}Even if that game we played was fun, the memory is very... How do I put it...?
{epi-nami}...mortifying. You forgot about it by now, right? Right...?
{epi-nami}In any case, they're looking for me. For your own sake you should leave this island as soon as possible.
{epi-nami}That pirate woman you met is "Black Rose" Sinclair.
{epi-nami}She has made this island her territory, taking advantage of the lack of Marine presence here in the last few years.
{epi-nami}I don't know much about her, but everybody here seems terrified of her.
{epi-nami}My crew got tangled up with her, and we had a bit of a confrontation...
{epi-nami}Which reminds me, how are you doing Zeus?
{epi-play}A cloud with a face comes out of Nami's weapon.
{epi}I'm gonna be okay, but she got me good, Nami.
{epi}I don't think I can help you until I fully recover.
{epi-nami}It's okay. I'm just glad you weren't badly hurt.
{epi-nami}Go sleep. I'll deal with it if necessary.
{epi}I'm sorry...
{epi-nami}Anyway, it wasn't a total loss for me.
{epi-nami}I borrowed this key from Sinclair.
{epi-nami}I happened to overhear that she has a room filled with treasure on this island, so I'm gonna find it and take it all!
{epi-nami}It's perfectly reasonable to be compensated when she hurt my companion. Am I right or am I right?
{epi-nami}So... I guess you should leave. It was nice seeing you again, but...
{epi-play}Suddenly, Nami steps forward and hugs you.
{epi-play}A loud couple walks into the alley.
{epi}What about here, honey? ♡
{epi}Whoops, there's already another couple on this spot. Sooorry, heeheeh... Let's find somewhere else!
{epi-play}Nami keeps her arms tightly around you for a few more seconds and doesn't move until they're far away.
{epi-nami}Sorry, I heard voices and I thought maybe it was Sinclair.
{epi-nami}...
{epi-nami}Uh, anyway...! Like I was saying...
{epi-play}Before Nami can finish her sentence, a pair of strong arms violently grab you from behind.
{epi-nami}Ahhh...! No!
{epi-sinclair}Well, I'll be damned... I'm glad I trusted my gut this time.
{epi-sinclair}But it seems I was wrong about the kind of woman you like, sugar. Ain't that a pity?
{epi-nami}Ugh, my Clima-Tact...
{epi-sinclair}Hold him tight, men. I'll deal with him shortly.
{epi-play}The two big men that were with Sinclair are grabbing your arms. They're giving you no wiggle room at all.
{epi-sinclair}I have to teach this naughty cat a lesson first.
{epi-nami}Hey, a pirate stealing from another pirate? That's to be expected, right?
{epi-sinclair}That's true, and I do intend to get back what's mine in full.
{epi-sinclair}But I ain't no doofus. I'm well aware what a big shot your captain is. So if you give me back my key willingly, I might let you go with jus' a few scratches...
{epi-nami}Key? What key...?
{epi-sinclair}Okay... If that's how you wanna play it, that's fine by me too.
{epi-sinclair}'Cause then I get to give you a little more than a few scratches...
{epi-nami}Wh-What the...?
{epi-play}Nami's body is engulfed in a pink light.
{epi-play}It only lasts for a second, and then...
{epi-nami}M-My clothes!
{epi-play}Her clothes have disappeared as if she had never been wearing them at all, leaving her only in her underwear.
{epi-sinclair}This is the ability of the Strip Strip fruit.
{epi-sinclair}Not the most powerful Devil Fruit, by any extent of the imagination, but it does come in handy real good now and then...
{epi-nami}I loved that outfit!
{epi-sinclair}Oh, hush your mouth. Like you got the right to complain about anythin' with these huge milkers.
{epi-sinclair}Hmph, I can't believe these tits are real... Life jus' ain't fair.
{epi-sinclair}But more importantly, seein' how my key didn't fall to the ground, I reckon you didn't have it in your pockets.
{epi-sinclair}I know you have it, sugar.
{epi-sinclair}And with how little fabric you got left, that means you only have a couple more hidin' spots.
{epi-sinclair}So let's try this again, shall we?
{epi-nami}W-Wait a second!
{epi-play}While Sinclair has been talking to Nami, her henchmen have been fidgeting. You hear them whispering to each other.
{epi}The captain is gonna remove her underwear! We're gonna see her...
{epi}W-We're gonna see a woman naked? Oh my... And she's so hot... S-So hot...
{epi-play}You don't exactly understand what happened, but the two thugs fall to the ground, unconscious and with a stupid grin on their faces. You're free!
{epi-sinclair}What the heck?! Haki...? Oh, it was these two thirsty meatheads. Why did I bring 'em with me?
{epi-sinclair}Maybe I shoulda let 'em keep their dirty magazines if this how they're gonna act...
{epi-nami}~Player~! Grab my Clima-Tact!
{epi-play}Without hesitation, you go for Nami's weapon.
{epi-play}As soon as you grab it, the pole extends and...
{epi-sinclair}Ugh!
{epi-sinclair}You son of a...
{epi-nami}Well done, ~player~! Let's get out of here! Quickly!
{epi-play}You grab Nami's hand, and run with her at full speed.
{epi-sinclair}No, you don't...
{epi-play}As you keep running, you think you see a pink flash off the corner of your eye, but you continue running without looking back.

scene.name: Escape

{epi-nami}We need to put some distance between us and her. I'm not thrilled about going through the town in my undergarments, but there's no other way.
{epi-nami}And on a rare day in which I didn't bother wearing matching underwear, no less...

{epi-nami}What the hell?! Why am I naked?!

{epi-play}An old lady notices Nami and starts yelling at her.
{epi}Young lady! This is outrageous! You go home and put clothes on right now!
{epi-nami}No, I'm not... Sh-Shut up, old hag!
{epi-play}The whispering only gets louder as more people notice Nami.
{epi}My goodness! I need to get my kids out of here.
{epi}Such a pretty girl, but so indecent...
{epi-nami}Why's everyone in this town so prudish?
{epi}Hey, guy! Move your hands! I can't see anything.
{epi-nami}Never mind...
{epi-nami}Let's pick up the pace, ~player~. And stay close to me!
{epi-play}As Nami starts walking faster, you're forced to stay right behind her so you can cover her breasts.
{epi-play}She doesn't notice that her butt has been rubbing against your crotch.
{epi-play}Your body naturally starts to react, so you try to put some distance between you two.
{epi-nami2}What are you doing, ~player~?! Stay right behind me!
{epi-play}Nami realizes that you're keeping some distance, which makes it hard to cover her properly.
{epi-nami2}I don't want anyone else to see more of my body... Just stay close to me.
{epi-play}You do as Nami says. Thankfully, she doesn't notice you touching.
{epi-play}Or at the very least she decided that it's not a priority right now.
{epi-play}You keep walking until you reach the edge of town without further complications.

scene.name: Vent
scene.directive: {epi-nami}Sigh... Finally, there's no more people here. That went about as bad as it could've gone.
{epi-nami}I swear, I'll come back here one day and take all of this town's money for this.
{epi-nami}At least it doesn't look like anyone followed us, but with how many people saw us it won't take long for Sinclair to find us.
{epi-nami}We need to hide somewhere... This air vent is loose. Help me open it.
{epi-play}You open the air vent, and quickly follow Nami inside.
{epi-nami}It's so dirty in here... I hope we find an exit soon.
{epi-nami}Hey! Don't you dare look forward! Just because you've already seen me naked doesn't mean I want you to see everything!
{epi-nami}If I catch you looking, I'll make you pay me 300,000 beli!
{epi-nami}I know it's ladies first, but there must be exceptions to that rule.
{epi-nami}A real gentleman would've gone first in this situation, if you ask me.
{epi-nami}If we're lucky, maybe this building will be a boutique. I really need a new set of clothes.
{epi-nami}Oh, I think I see a light...
{epi-play}You come to a sudden stop when you feel your face hit something soft.
{epi-nami}Ahhh...! Hey!!!
{epi-play}Then something else hits your face with great violence. Was that a foot?
{epi-play}Uh-oh...
{epi-nami}What the hell was that?! C-Can't you look where you're going?!
{epi-nami}Oh, right... I did tell you not to look... But I thought you'd keep your head down, not close your eyes!
{epi-nami}J-Just forget this ever happened and I'll do the same.
{epi-nami}There's an exit up ahead. Let's get the hell out of here.

scene.name: Storage
scene.directive: {epi-nami}This looks like a storage room. Well, at least we're alone.
{epi-nami}But I can't go out looking like this, and I don't think there's anything in here I can wear.
{epi-nami}Hey, uh, could you go see if you can find any clothes for me? And for you as well, so you don't get recognized.
{epi-nami}We don't know what kind of building this is, so be careful.
{epi-nami}Or whatever... I don't really care what happens to you. But I hope there's no security.
{epi-play}It seems Nami is still mad about what happened in the vent, even though it wasn't your fault.
{epi-nami}Oh, that reminds me...
{epi-play}She walks over to you, and puts her hand inside your pants' pocket. Whatever she's looking for in there, you hope she doesn't find something else instead.
{epi-nami}Excuse me...
{epi-nami}Here it is... Good thing I managed to slip this in your pocket right when Sinclair ambushed us.
{epi-nami}Ehem, well... You hold on to it for now. It's not like I have where to keep it.
{epi-play}She can't even look you in the eye when she asks you for a favor.
{epi-play}Right as you're about to leave through the door, you turn around to look at Nami.
{epi-play}Maybe it has nothing to do with what happened in the air vent. Maybe the reason she's acting cold is because she's not as comfortable being exposed like this as she wants you to think.
{epi-nami}Wh-What?
{epi-play}She flinches and takes a step back when you walk over to her.
{epi-play}Maybe this will help her feel less naked...
{epi-nami}...
{epi-nami}You didn't need to do that. If I wanted your clothes, I would've taken them already.
{epi-nami}Also we're gonna be changing soon...
{epi-nami}But... thanks.
{epi-play}You exit the storage room.

scene.name: Corridor
scene.directive: {epi-play}You're met with an empty corridor, and complete silence.
{epi-play}The walls are covered in dust, as if the building hasn't been used in some time. It looks like there's nobody around.
{epi-play}You walk through the corridors checking every room, trying to find a closet or a locker room.
{epi-play}You stop when you hear footsteps approaching.
{epi-play}A woman appears around the corner. Better hide inside one of those rooms before she sees you!
{epi}Hold it right there!
{epi-tashigi}What are you still doing here, cadet? And why aren't you in uniform?
{epi-tashigi}Hmmm... I'm sorry, but I don't think I recognize you. Are you new?
{epi-tashigi}It's been a little chaotic this morning with us settling into this abandoned base, and I haven't had the time to get to know the new recruits yet.
{epi}Captain Tashigi! We've received information on Sinclair's whereabouts.
{epi-tashigi}I'll be right there!
{epi-tashigi}The uniforms are in that room behind you. Make sure to get ready and then join the others.
{epi-tashigi}Now if you'll excuse me.
{epi-play}The woman promptly leaves. That was easy.
{epi-play}You go inside the closet, grab two uniforms, and then return to the storage room.
{epi-play}You stop outside the storage room door.
{epi-nami2}Ahhh... Ahhh...
{epi-play}You hear a voice coming from inside.
{epi-play}Is that Nami?
{epi-play}You open the door slightly and peek inside.
{epi-nami}Mmmgh... mmmm...
{epi-nami}Ahhh... What am I doing? This is stupid. I-I should stop...
{epi-nami}Mmmmgh...
{epi-nami}He's gonna come back any second...
{epi-nami}Wh-What if he sees me...? How would I...?
{epi-nami}Mmmgh...
{epi-nami}N-No... Too late... I'm gonna...!
{epi-nami}Ah... Mggh... Ahhhh!
{epi-nami}Ah... ah...
{epi-nami}Oh, shit! How am I gonna clean this up?!
{epi-nami}What can I... use?
{epi-nami}Hmmm...
{epi-play}You wait for one more minute outside the storage room before going inside.
{epi-nami}Oh, hey! There he is! Welcome back.
{epi-nami}I'm sorry, but your jacket got dirty somehow. I threw it away, no need to thank me.
{epi-nami}It's not a big loss, since we'll change clothes now anyway, right?
{epi-nami}Also, it didn't really suit you. But that's just my fashion sense speaking.
{epi-nami}So what do we have here?
{epi-nami}This is a Marine uniform... Does that mean we're in a Marine base?!
{epi-nami}I did hear that there was a Marine ship that arrived on this island. So they're here? Right now?
{epi-nami}Well, if there's one good thing to come out of this, it's that we know Sinclair won't follow us in here.
{epi-play}You both change into the uniforms.
{epi-nami}It's a little tight around the chest. But boy does it feel good to wear clothes again!
{epi-nami}Sooo... do I look cute? ♡ You probably prefer me without any clothes on, don't you? Yeah, no need to lie.
{epi-nami}We should be able to sneak out like this. I doubt there will be too many soldiers outside.
{epi-nami}By the way, you still have the key, right?
{epi-nami}I found this while I was clea-... I mean, while I was waiting for you.
{epi-nami}It's a map of the island. It might come in handy. How about you hold on to it too?
{epi-nami}Now let's get out of here.
{epi-play}You silently say goodbye to your jacket lying on the corner before exiting the storage room.

scene.name: Marine
scene.directive: {epi-nami}The coast is clear.
{epi-nami}This isn't my first time disguising as a Marine, so I have some experience pretending to be one.
{epi-nami}If we run into anyone, just keep your head down and avoid making eye contact. That way they won't give you any orders.
{epi-nami}Especially if they look like they are of a higher rank, and...
{epi-play}Nami stops talking when you notice Captain Tashigi walking down the corridor.
{epi-nami2}Oh, crap! She is here?! She knows who I am!
{epi-nami2}Okay, calm down, ~player~! Don't freak out! Let me do the talking.
{epi-tashigi}Good, I see you found the uniforms.
{epi-tashigi}Umm, are you also a new recruit?
{epi-nami}Yes!
{epi-tashigi}Although you do seem familiar...
{epi-nami}I, uh... cough I said good morning to you earlier today... ma'am.
{epi-tashigi}Ah, I see... I'm terribly sorry. It looks like I need to pay more attention to our new recruits.
{epi}Ring ring ring... Ring ring ring...
{epi}Clank...
{epi-tashigi}This is Tashigi.
{epi}Captain! Sinclair is right outside the base! She's calling for someone to come out.
{epi-tashigi}She came to us? I didn't think she'd be so daring.
{epi-tashigi}I don't like this. I'll handle it personally. Tell the men to stand down.
{epi-tashigi}You two come with me in case I need to call for backup.
{epi-tashigi}But make sure to stand behind me and let me handle any fighting.
{epi-nami}Y-Yes, ma'am.
{epi-nami}Uh-oh...
{epi-sinclair}Howdy! You sure left me waitin' for a while. That was rude.
{epi-sinclair}But I appreciate you showin' your pretty face at all.
{epi-tashigi}Of course I have! I am here under orders from Marine HQ to arrest you, Sinclair.
{epi-tashigi}You've held control over this island for long enough. Surrender peacefully.
{epi-sinclair}I wasn't talkin' to you, four-eyes.
{epi-sinclair}But you do have a lot of nerve to go after one pirate when you're standin' side by side with another.
{epi-tashigi}What are you talking about? You're the only pirate here.
{epi-sinclair}I reckon you need better glasses, sugar. Or maybe you jus' need to open your eyes.
{epi-sinclair}Lemme show you...
{epi-nami}Oh, crap...
{epi-sinclair}Flashing Rosa!
{epi-nami}Damn you! I just put those clothes on!
{epi-tashigi}The Straw Hat navigator?! You tricked me!
{epi-tashigi}Are you here to steal our uniforms?
{epi-nami}Why would I want your uniforms?!
{epi-tashigi}You clearly aren't up to anything good if you're disguising as my recruit.
{epi-nami}I was only passing through, I swear!
{epi-sinclair}Are you two done bickerin'?
{epi-sinclair}I know you Marines came here for me. I get it, it's your job.
{epi-sinclair}But I only have business with these two. So why don't you go take a hike and leave us alone, four-eyes?
{epi-tashigi}As if! It's shameful enough on the Marines that we've let you do as you please on this island for so long, Sinclair.
{epi-tashigi}I'll capture you both!
{epi-nami}Are you serious?! She's the bad one!
{epi-tashigi}I can't let pirates put the people of this island in further danger with their own conflicts...
{epi-nami}Fine then! ~Player~, get ready to run...
{epi-play}Nami quickly takes her Clima-Tact out of its holster and readies it before the other two can react.
{epi-nami}Now!
{epi-sinclair}Shit... What's this? Fog?!
{epi-tashigi}My glasses... I can't see!
{epi-sinclair}I won't let you escape again, thief!
{epi-tashigi}You're not getting away from me, Sinclair!
{epi-sinclair}Fuck!
{epi-play}You run with Nami into the forest, and continue running until you're too tired to keep going.

scene.name: Planning
scene.directive: {epi-nami}Huff, huff... Looks like we lost them.
{epi-nami}Can you believe this? I couldn't keep my new clothes on for longer than a minute...
{epi-nami}Sigh... I think I'm done chasing Sinclair's treasure.
{epi-nami}It's not worth all this risk and humiliation.
{epi-nami}I'm sorry I got you involved in this, ~player~. All you've done is help me, and all I've done is boss you around.
{epi-nami}This is when we should part. Sinclair will leave you alone if you aren't with me, and now that the Marines are also in the mix...
{epi-nami}I'll just go back to my ship.
{epi-play}It's sad seeing Nami so disheartened.
{epi-play}You shouldn't leave her alone right now, but she would never accept you to accompany her for her protection. So there's only one option...
{epi-nami}What? You want to help me get that treasure?
{epi-nami}But it's gonna be dangerous... I wouldn't want you to get hurt.
{epi-nami}Well... I guess we can split it... 60-40? How does that sound?
{epi-nami}Alright! My strength is back! Let's do this, partner.
{epi-nami}You still have that map I gave you, right? Let's take a look at it.
{epi-nami}It's... a little crudely drawn. But it will do.
{epi-nami}So this is the port town where we met.
{epi-nami}Now we've left the town and entered the forest, so we should be here.
{epi-nami}From what I learned, Sinclair's treasure is at the very top of this mountain in the middle of the island.
{epi-nami}But there's a lake surrounding it, and it looks like the only way there is this bridge, on the other side of the island.
{epi-nami}It must also be guarded by Sinclair's crew or the Marines, so we can discard that as an option.
{epi-nami}But I have a plan. For now, we should make it to the shore of the lake from our side. I'll show you when we get there.
{epi-nami}Alright! So that's the plan.
{epi-nami}This is exciting! Let's goooo...!
{epi-nami}Ooops...!
{epi-play}Nami gets up too quickly and trips, falling on top of you.
{epi-nami}Ouch... Sorry, are you okay?
{epi-nami}Here, I'll help you up.
{epi-play}Nami grabs your arm to help you get on your feet.
{epi-nami}Ah...!
{epi-play}But something startles her as she's holding on to your arm.
{epi-play}She pushes you down to the ground, with you on top this time. Was she always this clumsy?
{epi-nami}~Player~?
{epi-nami}Umm...
{epi-play}Nami doesn't say anything, or pushes you out of the way.
{epi-play}She simply stares directly into your eyes for what feels like minutes.
{epi-play}And then...
{epi-nami}...
{epi-play}Does she want you to...?
{epi-play}You start moving your face closer to Nami's...
{epi-play}Next thing you know, your arms are bent backwards with overwhelming force and you're violently pushed away.

scene.name: Forest A
scene.directive: {epi-play}A set of disembodied hands growing out of your own body have you in a chokehold.
{epi-robin}What are you doing to Nami?! This is unforgivable!
{epi-play}The hands tighten around your body, causing you inmense pain.
{epi-play}In a last moment of clarity you wonder what will happen first: you losing consciousness or your bones breaking.
{epi-nami}Robin, wait! He wasn't doing anything to me.
{epi-robin}Are you okay, Nami?
{epi-nami}Yes. He's a friend. He's been helping me.
{epi-play}Just as swiftly as they appeared, the hands vanish from your body without leaving a trace.
{epi-robin}I apologize. I saw the Marine uniform and I jumped to the wrong conclusion.
{epi-robin}I assume it's simply a disguise?
{epi-nami}We stole the uniforms from the base.
{epi-robin}What happened to yours, Nami?
{epi-nami}Sinclair destroyed it with her ability.
{epi-nami}Oh, this is ~player~, by the way. ~Player~, this is my crewmate, Robin.
{epi-robin}~Player~? The same one you played that game with?
{epi-nami}Uh, d-did I mention him? I'm not sure...
{epi-nami}Anyway, how are the guys?
{epi-robin}They've wiped out Sinclair's crew, and now they've been staying away from the Marines. Or at least trying.
{epi-nami}I see. ~Player~ and I still need to go get Sinclair's treasure. We're gonna split it 70-30.
{epi-nami}I would not have made it this far without him.
{epi-robin}Is that so? You do seem like you've been having fun.
{epi-nami2}Robin, stop...{!reset}
{epi}Stop right there!
{epi-tashigi}Nico Robin! You're here too... Sinclair escaped, but I can still capture you two.
{epi-nami}Why don't you give up already?
{epi-robin}You're clearly outmatched here, Ms. Marine.
{epi-tashigi}I can't forgive you when you've kidnapped one of my men!
{epi-play}Tashigi's comment is met with silence for a moment, while everybody processes what she's saying.
{epi-nami}Wha...? You mean him? He's not one of your men!
{epi-tashigi}Oh...
{epi-tashigi}A-And what about your indecent exposure? I heard reports about a naked woman running through town. I never thought it'd be you!
{epi-nami}That wasn't voluntary!
{epi-robin}I don't think we'll get anywhere trying to reason with her, Nami. You two go ahead, and I'll handle her.
{epi-nami}Thanks, Robin. Come on, ~player~!
{epi-play}The sounds of Robin and Tashigi fighting fade away behind your back as you follow Nami deeper into the trees.
{epi-play}After running for a while, Nami stops.

scene.name: Forest B
scene.directive: {epi-robin}My, my... If it isn't ~player~.
{epi-robin}My apologies. I didn't know it was you wearing a Marine uniform.
{epi-robin}If you don't mind me saying, I much prefer your former choice of outfit.
{epi-nami}Robin!
{epi-robin}Are you okay, Nami?
{epi-nami}Yeah! Only my pride has been hurt so far.
{epi-robin}I'm glad. So did you lose that rematch game you wanted to have with ~player~?
{epi-nami}What...? No, I lost my clothes because of Sinclair's ability.
{epi-robin}I see. It was very foolish of me to interrupt your moment together. I apologize.
{epi-nami}Moment? Wh-What moment? There was no moment. Nothing was happening.
{epi-robin}Is that so? Because it seemed to me that you two were going to ki-...
{epi-nami}COUGH, COUGH, COUGH!
{epi-robin}Is your throat okay, Nami? I was saying I thought you two were...
{epi}Stop right there!
{epi-nami2}Oh, thank goodness...
{epi-tashigi}Nico Robin! You're here too... Sinclair escaped, but I can still capture you two.
{epi-nami}Why don't you give up already?
{epi-robin}You're clearly outmatched here, Ms. Marine.
{epi-tashigi}I can't forgive you when you've kidnapped one of my men!
{epi-play}Tashigi's comment is met with silence for a moment, while everybody processes what she's saying.
{epi-nami}Wha...? You mean him? He's not one of your men!
{epi-tashigi}Oh...
{epi-tashigi}A-And what about your indecent exposure? I heard reports about a naked woman running through town. I never thought it'd be you!
{epi-nami}That wasn't voluntary!
{epi-robin}I don't think we'll get anywhere trying to reason with her, Nami. You two go ahead, and I'll handle her.
{epi-nami}Thanks, Robin. Come on, ~player~!
{epi-play}The sounds of Robin and Tashigi fighting fade away behind your back as you follow Nami deeper into the trees.
{epi-play}After running for a while, Nami stops.

scene.name: Shore
scene.directive: {epi-nami}There's the shore! We've reached the lake.
{epi-nami}Huh? What...?
{epi-play}What Nami thought was a lake turned out to be a giant whirlpool surrounding the small isle on the center.
{epi-play}The water flows continously with such force that there's no doubt that any boat would be destroyed in an instant.
{epi-nami}So... Vortex Island, huh? I thought it was a weird name.
{epi-nami}It'd be impossible to get through such a strong current with any conventional methods.
{epi-nami}But there's no need to worry. I'll use my Clima-Tact to create a bridge of clouds so we can get over the whirlpool.
{epi-nami}This should only take a minute. You keep watch in the meantime, ~player~.
{epi-play}While Nami is working, you hear rustling sounds coming from the forest.
{epi-play}Robin and Tashigi jump out of the trees, still in combat. They sure moved a lot during their fight.
{epi-tashigi}Your ability won't work on me like it did in Alabasta!
{epi-robin}I have other techniques at my disposal now.
{epi-nami}Dammit... I can't do anything while I'm busy here!
{epi-nami}~Player~, be careful. Don't get too close to them.
{epi-robin}I would rather not break any of your pretty bones this time, Ms. Marine.
{epi-tashigi}You don't have to hold back against me.
{epi-tashigi}I need to finish this quickly so I can go after Sinclair.
{epi-sinclair}Did you call for me?
{epi-play}Sinclair appears out of nowhere.
{epi-sinclair}Estrada Espinhosa!
{epi-robin}Oh, my...
{epi-tashigi}Ahhh...!
{epi-nami}Oh no... This is bad.
{epi-sinclair}Look at y'all havin' a party without me. You should feel embarrassed.
{epi-sinclair}You're Nico Robin, aren't ya? I reckon I'll have to take care of you too.
{epi-robin}Being naked won't affect me. I've fought under worse circumstances.
{epi-tashigi}M-M-Me too... Not that I've ever fought naked, but I can't let this get to me.
{epi-sinclair}Oh, bless your hearts! Putting aside your differences 'cause of me. Maybe I should become a counsellor, I tell you what.
{epi-sinclair}If you're gonna gang up on poor ol' me, I reckon I don't have to play fair either.
{epi-play}In the blink of an eye, Sinclair moves behind you and puts her sword to your neck.
{epi-nami}~Player~!
{epi-robin}I can disarm you in less than a second, Sinclair.
{epi-sinclair}Try it if you want. That is if you think I won't be able to cut his neck first.
{epi-robin}...
{epi-tashigi}Don't hurt him! He's innocent!
{epi-sinclair}Hmph, we'll see...
{epi-sinclair}What I want to find out is what you're hidin' in your pants, boy toy.
{epi-play}The pink light covers your body, as the Marine uniform you're wearing completely disappears.
{epi-play}The key that was in your pocket falls to the ground.
{epi-sinclair}Ah, there's my key. I'll be takin' this back.
{epi-sinclair}Wait... Is it my idea or are you seriously gettin' a bon-...?
{epi-robin}She's distracted! Now!
{epi-tashigi}Right!
{epi-play}Robin uses her ability to separate you from Sinclair.
{epi-play}Tashigi slashes Sinclair, who's barely able to block her attack as she's sent flying towards the trees.
{epi-sinclair}Ugh, dammit!
{epi-play}Robin's arms appear on the trees and restrain Sinclair's body in position.
{epi-robin}Are you alright, ~player~?
{epi-tashigi}I'm glad she didn't hurt you.
{epi-tashigi}B-But you should cover your intimate parts... Well, we all should.
{epi-robin}I can use my ability to cover myself.
{epi-robin}Would you like me to help you, Ms. Marine?
{epi-tashigi}I... pass.
{epi-play}You pick up Sinclair's key and then walk over to Nami.
{epi-nami}You're okay, right? She didn't hurt you?
{epi-play}Nami seems to be having trouble making eye contact again. Is she still mad at you? But what did you do?
{epi-nami}Well, uh... The bridge is finished. Do you have the... what do you call it? The key? Then let's go...
{epi-play}You follow Nami through the bridge of clouds.
{epi-nami}I guess you've never walked on clouds before. I know they're spongey, but the bridge should be firm.
{epi-sinclair}No...
{epi-sinclair}I'm not...
{epi-sinclair}...gonna lose!
{epi-play}Sinclair manages to free one of her arms, picks up her sword and throws it...
{epi-play}...at the base of the cloud bridge.
{epi-nami}What's happening?!
{epi-robin}The bridge... Nami!
{epi-robin}The bridge... Nami! ~Player~!
{epi-tashigi}Sinclair broke free! Watch out!
{epi-nami}Ahhhh!!!
{epi-play}Right before you're dragged by the unrelenting force of the whirlpool you manage to grab Nami's hand.
{epi-play}Then everything fades to black.

scene.name: Dream
scene.directive: {epi}~Player~! Hey, ~player~!
{epi}Please, don't give up!
{epi-nami}Come on, you have to wake up...!
{epi}It's useless.
{epi-robin}He's nothing but a drowned, bloated corpse now.
{epi-nami}Don't say that...
{epi-robin}No point in crying for him. I have it in good authority that he won't be coming here, after all.
{epi-robin}A cute angel like yourself shouldn't look so sad. Allow me to remedy that.
{epi-nami}Ahhh! Wh-Where are you touching?!
{epi-robin}Shhhh... Let me take care of you, my sweet angel.
{epi-nami}Ahhh... Ahhh!
{epi-nami}You shouldn't lick me there...! It's not appropriate...
{epi-robin}Slurp
{epi-robin}Is that so? Everything your body tells me is how much you're enjoying this.
{epi-robin}You're the naughtiest angel I've ever met.
{epi-nami}N-No... I'm a good angel.
{epi-nami}Ah...!
{epi-robin}No need to speak. Let our bodies do the talking.
{epi-nami}Mmmm, I can't believe I've never done this before...
{epi-robin}Fufufu... Isn't physical pleasure delightful?
{epi-robin}Your body, so honest and delicious...
{epi-robin}Too bad ~player~ can't join us anymore. Where he's going there's nothing but pain.
{epi-nami}~Player~... Who was that?
{epi-robin}Exactly...
{epi-tashigi}Ahhh... Ahhh...
{epi-tashigi}Th-That looks fun...
{epi-robin}Ms. Marine? Of course you came here. A good girl like you...
{epi-robin}Why don't you join us? The more, the merrier.
{epi-robin}Sit on her face.
{epi-tashigi}L-Like this?
{epi-nami}Mmmgghph... Mmmgh!
